newsitem.title: USA: CheckFree starts two-way pc bill service.
newsitem.headline: CheckFree starts two-way pc bill service.

text.p: CheckFree Corp said Tuesday it was releasing CheckFree E-Bill, a web-based service that allows consumers to both receive and pay bills electronically through a personal computer.

CheckFree said customers will be presented with full-color, electronic bills including graphics, logos and full billing detail. The information typically printed on the back of a bill is also available for viewing. Once paid, customers can store the bill electronically for future reference.
CheckFree said billing companies can lower billing costs by as much as one-third.
CheckFree said nine companies including several utilities have signed up for the service and some are already using it.

Customers use the service by going to a central web site to receive bills. The customer will find an electronic check already filled out and waiting for approval and the transaction can be completed with a few mouse clicks, CheckFree said.
